description: Semantic search over the Proximens GEO Engine: a curated, continuously-updated knowledge base of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/AEO) principles built from our own measurements and research, each graded by a 0-1 confidence score. INPUT: query (REQUIRED, natural language, 3-500 chars, e.g. "how does ChatGPT choose which FAQ to cite"); optional category (one of 13 GEO categories), top_k (1-25, default 10), min_confidence (0-1, default 0.5). RETURNS: ranked principles as JSON, each with id, title, summary, category, confidence and a relevance score; Pro/Enterprise tiers additionally return full_text. USE WHEN you need evidence-backed answers about how AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Copilot) select, rank and cite web content.

category.description: Filter by category (one of 13 GEO categories)

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence score (0-1). Default 0.5 filters noise; raise to 0.8+ for high-confidence claims only

query.description: Natural-language search query (e.g. "schema markup for local businesses" or "how to optimize for ChatGPT citations")

name: proximens_geo_search_principles

tier_note.description: Free-tier hint when top_k was capped

title: Search GEO principles (Proximens GEO Engine)
